events.title: The Wrong Side of the Label

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Please tell me you haven't stepped on the little pink paper star. That's the only one I got the cut right on.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Is this for a tournament?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: A showcase. Deck boxes, playmats, stuff you can actually touch. The shop said I can borrow one table if nothing smells like paint.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Your designs look good.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: They're mine, which isn't quite the same. People keep asking whether someone else drew them.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Sorry. That got serious. Want to help me make the display not look like a yard sale?

choices.label: Help arrange the display by color
choices.reply: You have excellent taste. Don't let that go to your head; I need you to hold this corner.

choices.label: Ask why she has to prove the designs are hers
choices.reply: Because 'cute' gets called a hobby and 'serious' gets called a business. I want them to be both.

choices.label: Tell her her work is hard to ignore
choices.reply: Careful. My ego barely fits under this cap already. ...Thanks, though.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Don't look at the score machine. I just won a game with a deck box that's held together by tape.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Are you testing it in the arcade?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Field test. Official scientific term for dropping things on purpose.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: And the problem?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: A store wants fifty units with their logo covering mine. Fifty is a lot. My name disappearing is also a lot.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I could use someone to argue with me instead of saying whatever sounds nice.

choices.label: Suggest negotiating a small co-branded run
choices.reply: Okay. So it's not no, it's a different yes. I can work with that.

choices.label: Ask what matters more: cash or the signature
choices.reply: Both. That's the annoying part. I can want rent money and still want to be proud of the work.

choices.label: Say her signature belongs where people can see it
choices.reply: Well, now I really have to design a signature worth staring at, don't I?

openingByFlag.barb_display_help: You helped me make the display. Guess who noticed the arrangement? The buyer with the giant logo.
openingByFlag.barb_display_why: You asked why I care about authorship. A buyer just made that question complicated.
openingByFlag.barb_display_flirt: You said my work was hard to ignore. A shop noticed it and is now trying to cover my name.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I made a mockup. Then another. Then twelve more. None of them felt like me.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You sound tired.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I can stay up all night fixing a seam. Turns out you can't seam-rip a decision.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Have you told the buyer you're uncomfortable?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I wrote the message three times. Saved the draft. Deleted the draft. Classic me.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I'm not asking you to solve this. Just don't pretend it isn't scary.

choices.label: Sit with her while she writes the message
choices.reply: You didn't touch the keyboard. You just stayed. I think that's why I could hit send.

choices.label: Admit you would be afraid to send it too
choices.reply: Good. I thought everyone else had some secret bravery manual.

choices.label: Tell her being nervous makes her courage matter more
choices.reply: That was unfairly sweet. I was prepared for sarcasm. Give me a second.

openingByFlag.barb_prototype_negotiate: I tried writing the co-branding proposal you suggested. It's sitting in my drafts.
openingByFlag.barb_prototype_values: Remember when I said I wanted both? I think I have to say it out loud to the buyer.
openingByFlag.barb_prototype_signature: My signature is still on the mockup. I just need to convince myself I can ask for it.

events.title: The Table With Her Name On It

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I have exactly three minutes before the showcase opens, and the table banner is upside down.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Want a hand?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Yes—please don't laugh. They said yes to the smaller run with both logos.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You did it.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: We did the argument part. I had to do the sending part. My hands shook like I was flipping for turn one.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: What if everyone likes the work, then asks somebody taller and louder who made it?

choices.label: Stand beside her but let her introduce the work
choices.reply: I kept expecting you to step in. You didn't. That felt like you believed I could do it.

choices.label: Help turn the banner right-side up and rehearse
choices.reply: A thirty-second rehearsal. A huge difference. You're welcome at my table any time.

choices.label: Say you came to cheer for the artist, not the display
choices.reply: Stop. I'm going to smile at the wrong time and embarrass myself in front of customers.

openingByFlag.barb_cafe_stay: You sat with me while I sent the message. They answered. Here we are.
openingByFlag.barb_cafe_honest: You said you would be scared too. I sent it scared. Turns out that counts.
openingByFlag.barb_cafe_courage: I kept what you said in my head when I finally hit send. Don't get smug about it.

events.title: A Design With Space Left Open

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I brought my sketchbook, but I haven't drawn a single line. I'm trying a new thing called 'having a day off.'

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: How's it going?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Terribly. I keep measuring clouds for card sleeves.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: At least things are moving with your designs.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: They are. And I realized I don't want every choice made for me, even the nice ones.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I can keep making room for my work. I think I might want to make room for someone, too. No pressure for either of us.

choices.label: Tell her you value the quiet days too
choices.reply: Then we can leave the next page blank for a while. I think I'd like that.

choices.label: Say you will respect the time she needs
choices.reply: Good. I like someone who knows an invitation isn't an obligation.

choices.label: Ask if she wants to explore something more together
choices.reply: I do. Slowly, on purpose, with actual communication. This is extremely off-brand for me.

openingByFlag.barb_showcase_space: Thanks for letting me speak for myself at the showcase. I'm still thinking about that.
openingByFlag.barb_showcase_practice: The rehearsal worked. Turns out I can introduce my own work without swallowing my words.
openingByFlag.barb_showcase_artist: You made me grin through my whole showcase. That is an official complaint.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Okay. Before you say anything: this zipper and I are having a private disagreement.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Your jacket won?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: It won the first round. I was testing a new fastening system, and apparently I tested it on myself.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Is that why you are standing perfectly still?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I am standing *strategically*. If I move, the little metal pull disappears into the lining.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Want me to take a look?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: At the zipper. Eyes on the zipper, troublemaker. And if you laugh, I am adding a surcharge.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You charge your rescuers?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Only the cute ones. Now hold the fabric steady while I work the pull free.

choices.label: Hold the jacket steady and follow her instructions
choices.reply: See? A steady hand, no panic, and my dignity is only slightly damaged. You are hired.

choices.label: Ask her to show you what went wrong
choices.reply: The teeth are fine; I sewed the lining too close. That is actually useful feedback.

choices.label: Tell her the design looks great, even unfinished
choices.reply: Oh, do not distract the designer while she is trapped in her own masterpiece. ...Thank you.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: HEY! Give that back, you extremely rude weather!

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Your hat?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Hat, hair, skirt, personal dignity. The wind is collecting the entire set.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I think you caught most of it.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: If you saw me wrestle the atmosphere, no you did not.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: There is a bench out of the wind behind us.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Oh, now it stops? The second I am ready to fight a cloud?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You were going to fight a cloud?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: And I would have won. I have excellent accessories and terrible judgment.

choices.label: Offer to carry her bag while she fixes her hat
choices.reply: Thanks. You are officially on wind-defense duty. The pay is terrible, but the company is good.

choices.label: Suggest taking the sheltered route
choices.reply: A practical idea. Annoying how attractive competence can be.

choices.label: Say the wind could not ruin her look
choices.reply: That line was shameless. ...Do you have another one?

openingByFlag.barb_zipper_help: You already helped me defeat a zipper. Think you can take on the weather too?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Do not call for help. I am not stuck.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You have been trying to remove that sleeve for a minute.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: That is called a fitting test. The result is that my elbows have been canceled.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Did you make the jacket?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Customized it. Took the seams in a little. Okay, a lot. It looked perfect on the mannequin.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Mannequins are not known for moving.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Neither am I, apparently. Can you unzip the cuff while I stop pretending this was deliberate?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Only if you admit I was right.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I will admit the mannequin was suspiciously unhelpful. Final offer.

choices.label: Carefully release the cuff seam
choices.reply: Freedom! I have never appreciated elbows this much. Thank you for not yanking the fabric.

choices.label: Help her measure a better fit
choices.reply: Good. Real measurements, real movement. I might even learn from this.

choices.label: Call it an unforgettable runway pose
choices.reply: If you take a photo I will haunt your wardrobe. ...But you may compliment the jacket.

openingByFlag.barb_zipper_help: Do you have a talent for finding me at precisely the wrong moment with precisely the right tools?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Do NOT delete that photo.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: The one where you tripped over the camera cable?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Especially that one. My carefully rehearsed poses were terrible, and my emergency landing looked editorial.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Are you hurt?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Only my pride. And that was already on clearance.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: The lighting did catch your outfit perfectly.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Right? The skirt moved, the hair moved, and somehow the camera understood my entire design philosophy.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Controlled chaos?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Exactly. Except with very little control. Could you help me check the other shots before I make it worse?

choices.label: Check that she is okay, then review the pictures
choices.reply: Thanks for asking first. I am fine—and this one is actually going on my portfolio.

choices.label: Offer to move the cable and reset the shoot
choices.reply: Excellent. Safety first, accidental genius second. A responsible production at last.

choices.label: Tell her even her mistakes look like magazine covers
choices.reply: You know, I would accuse you of flirting if that were not a genuinely great caption.

openingByFlag.barb_jacket_rescue: You saw the jacket disaster. Apparently my wardrobe has decided to become an extreme sport.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I need to negotiate a tiny favor.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: That sounds suspiciously formal for the pool.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I am completely capable of sunscreen. Except for the bit between my shoulders, because apparently I was not built with detachable arms.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You could ask nicely.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I *am* asking nicely. This is my professional nice voice.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: What is in it for me?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: One debt repaid, plus a very prestigious title: Official Defender Against Sunburn.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Only if you promise to stop trying to skip sunscreen.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Deal. You have my solemn word, delivered from this extremely comfortable lounge chair.

choices.label: Help with the sunscreen on her shoulders
choices.reply: Thank you. That is one fewer weirdly shaped sunburn for the scrapbook.

choices.label: Hand her a long-handled applicator instead
choices.reply: Of course you brought an actual solution. Fine, that is impressively clever.

choices.label: Accept the title with an exaggerated bow
choices.reply: Your service has been noted, brave knight of SPF fifty. Try not to look so pleased.

openingByFlag.barb_wind_hat: At least there is no wind to steal my hat today. I learned to keep the emergency hair tie nearby.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I have invented a new type of outfit.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Should I be worried?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: It comes with a built-in desk. I accidentally stitched my skirt to a strip of fabric still attached to the sewing machine.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: That explains why you are sitting so carefully.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: This is a dignified design consultation. Ignore the loose thread connecting me to my own furniture.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Did you try cutting it?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Yes, then remembered the thread is holding a finished hem. I need a third hand and a second brain.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I can supply one of those.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Great. You be the brain. I will continue providing highly entertaining commentary.

choices.label: Hold the fabric while she unpicks the seam
choices.reply: Perfect. Nobody gets stabbed by a seam ripper and the hem survives. A rare double victory.

choices.label: Suggest tracing the stray stitch before pulling
choices.reply: You spotted the problem faster than I did. Okay, we save the good stitches and sacrifice the rest.

choices.label: Declare it the first wearable sewing machine
choices.reply: I hate that I laughed. Do not put that in the product catalog. Actually—write it down.

openingByFlag.barb_jacket_rescue: Remember the jacket that nearly ate my elbows? My sewing machine has clearly taken its side.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Do not move. I need to look right there.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: At me?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: At the tiny clasp stuck to your hoodie. It is from the charm I was making.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You are very close.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I have noticed. My glasses are on the other side of the room, and my pride refused to walk back for them.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Did you find it?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Yes. It is smaller than a rice grain and more committed to mischief than I am.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: That is a high bar.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Hush. I am concentrating. ...There. Rescue complete. Why are *you* blushing?

choices.label: Hold still so she can retrieve it
choices.reply: Thank you. You have the patience of a saint and the hoodie of a hardware store.

choices.label: Offer to get her glasses next time
choices.reply: Fair. My stubbornness is not an accessibility strategy. Point taken.

choices.label: Say you did not mind the close inspection
choices.reply: Careful, I might start charging for personal attention.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I have a very serious diplomatic proposal.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Does it involve that cake?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: One forkful. Strawberry, chocolate, and a legally binding agreement that you tell me whether it is actually good.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Why do you need a second opinion?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Because I spent ten minutes photographing it instead of eating it, which means I may have lost objectivity.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You really are a designer even at dessert.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Every dessert deserves a mood board. Now open up before I eat the evidence.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: And if I love it?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Then we split the last bite. That is how peace treaties work.

choices.label: Take the offered bite and share your verdict
choices.reply: Yes! Excellent. I chose well, and now you are officially my cake consultant.

choices.label: Ask if she took a picture of the slice first
choices.reply: Obviously. And the composition is better than my last portfolio shoot. Do not tell anyone.

choices.label: Say sharing makes it taste better
choices.reply: Ugh, that was terribly sweet. Unfortunately it was also correct.

openingByFlag.barb_camera_cable: After my accidental runway moment, I have been studying the camera angle on everything—including pastries.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I am doing absolutely nothing for five minutes. It is a bold experiment.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You are lying on a pile of half-finished projects.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Exactly. If I sit at the desk, I will start fixing them. Down here I can pretend my deadlines do not exist.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You look like you want to say something.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Only that I am glad you came by. The workshop is less noisy when I do not have to explain every unfinished thing.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Want some company?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Yes. But do not be useful. Being useful will ruin the experiment.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I can manage that.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Perfect. Five minutes. Then we can argue about whether the pink stitching is too much.

choices.label: Sit beside her without trying to fix anything
choices.reply: Thank you. I do not always need a solution. Sometimes I just need a person.

choices.label: Tell her breaks count as work too
choices.reply: You sound suspiciously sensible. I should embroider that on a pillow.

choices.label: Say five minutes with her sounds like a good deal
choices.reply: Do not make me smile during my extremely serious rest period.

openingByFlag.barb_sewing_rescue: After our sewing-table incident, I am trying a radical new idea: leaving the fabric alone for a while.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Okay. First rule: nobody is allowed to laugh if I miss the chord.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I thought you were teaching me.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I am. Which is why I need you to maintain a respectful silence about my dramatic failures.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: That is not how lessons usually work.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I designed a deck box from a napkin sketch. I never claimed to be a qualified music teacher.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Where does my finger go?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Here. No, the other fret. You have excellent instincts and absolutely no hand coordination.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Harsh.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Accurate. One more try, and then I will show you the song I keep pretending I wrote.

choices.label: Practice slowly until the chord sounds right
choices.reply: There! You did it. I am ridiculously proud of both of us.

choices.label: Ask why she picked up guitar in the first place
choices.reply: My cousin left one at home and I liked the noise. Turns out liking something is enough reason to begin.

choices.label: Say you will only practice if she stays close
choices.reply: Flattery will not improve your timing. ...It may improve mine, though.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Hold this pose. Two seconds.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Are you drawing me?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Your jacket cuff. The fold is doing this perfect diagonal thing, and if you move I will lose it.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I did not know sleeves could be inspiring.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Everything is inspiring if you stare at it long enough. Even that tragic mug you keep bringing around.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: What is the pink marker for?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: A little accent line. It makes the design feel less serious. A reminder that I do not have to impress everyone.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Looks like it worked.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Maybe. Or maybe I just like having somebody around who actually notices the details.

choices.label: Hold the pose until she finishes
choices.reply: Perfect. Thank you. I have a whole page of ideas now, all because you stood still.

choices.label: Ask how the accent color changes the design
choices.reply: See? The pink breaks up the black without making it softer. You get it.

choices.label: Ask if she is drawing your jacket or finding excuses to stare
choices.reply: It can be two things. Do not look so pleased with yourself.

openingByFlag.barb_display_help: Remember arranging the display together? This is the color combination I could not quite settle on.
